_comment: Smart Cauldron conductor ruleset v1.3. Rules are evaluated top-down; first match wins (ANY-of match on tags). defaultEntry fires when no rule matches. woClass/tags are supplied entirely by the CLI caller via --class/--tags (smart-cauldron does not parse WO frontmatter itself) -- a WO 'acquires' a tag only if the caller passes it explicitly on the command line. 2026-07-07: mechanical CODE work now routes to zero, an exhaustion lane with no paid review seat. Money/auth/infra stay on the stronger lane. 2026-09-29 (John, extension of M-20260929h: cursor grok lanes become the new lanes): plain CODE (no tags) and defaultEntry now enter at cursor instead of codex; mechanical CODE stays on zero (the documented fallback lane when the Codex seat is the constraint); feature/net-new/multi-surface stays on codex; the Claude lane stays shut (billing/auth/INFRA rules unchanged). Seat-headroom routing (headroom.ts) still moves entry off any seat past the threshold. 2026-10-21 (John): billing/money/payment/stripe, auth/oauth/security, INFRA, and feature/net-new/multi-surface enter at cursor because Codex 429s fail back onto the Claude seat. Mechanical CODE stays on zero; codex remains the next climb rung; claude stays refused. 2026-11-02 (WO-HARNESS-ZERO-TIER-FENCES-AND-FLOOR-01, John ruling on bdc-xo#4282 + M-20261027a r6 item 5): plain CODE (no tags) now enters at zero instead of cursor, under five fences (one-climb-then-stop via ladder maxClimbsByEntry, open-model review kept on zero-open, allow_issue_fallback false, one run row per rung, first-10 measurement). THE REVERT IS ONE VALUE: change the last rule (woClass CODE, no tags) entry back from zero to cursor; billing/auth/INFRA/feature/mechanical rules and defaultEntry are unchanged.
